texts.orig: In this article; we provide modification to the Bregman Golden Ratio Algorithm (B-GRAAL) . We analyze the B-GRAAL algorithm with a new step size rule; where the step size increases after a certain number of iterations and not require prior knowledge of the global Lipschitz constant   of the cost operator. Under   suitable assumptions, we establish the global iterate convergence as   well as the R-linear rate of convergence of the modified algorithm. The numerical performance of the proposed approach is validated for the matrix problem and the sparse logistic regression problem in machine learning. does game
